title: chionanthus pauciflorus var. evolutior
intro: Chionanthus pauciflorus var. evolutior, commonly known as Chinese Fringe Tree, is a plant species in the family Oleaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments and is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Fringe Tree include anti-anxiety, anti-depressant, and anti-inflammatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of Chinese Fringe Tree, including flavonoids like kaempferol and quercetin, phenolic acids like caffeic acid, and alkaloids like aucubin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
